Running command: cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json << 'EOF'
[
  {
    "step": 1,
    "file": "fuzzing/FuzzStunClient.c",
    "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput",
    "line": 130,
    "var": "Data/Size",
    "code": "harness_channel_data(Data, Size);",
    "note": "Fuzzer entry point receives 8192 bytes of attacker-controlled input (all 0x41, no null bytes) and dispatches to the channel-data harness."
  },
  {
    "step": 2,
    "file": "fuzzing/FuzzStunClient.c",
    "function": "harness_channel_data",
    "line": 55,
    "var": "Size",
    "code": "if (Size < 4 || Size > 8192) return;",
    "note": "Size=8192 passes the bounds check, allowing the full 8192-byte input to proceed."
  },
  {
    "step": 3,
    "file": "fuzzing/FuzzStunClient.c",
    "function": "harness_channel_data",
    "line": 58,
    "var": "buf",
    "code": "uint8_t buf[8192] = {0}; memcpy(buf, Data, Size);",
    "note": "8192-byte stack buffer is completely filled with non-zero input bytes; no null terminator exists within the buffer bounds."
  },
  {
    "step": 4,
    "file": "fuzzing/FuzzStunClient.c",
    "function": "harness_channel_data",
    "line": 70,
    "var": "mlen_tcp",
    "code": "int mlen_tcp = stun_get_message_len_str(buf, Size, 1, &app_len_tcp);",
    "note": "Calls stun_get_message_len_str with the full 8192-byte non-null-terminated buffer."
  },
  {
    "step": 5,
    "file": "src/client/ns_turn_msg.c",
    "function": "stun_get_message_len_str",
    "line": 899,
    "var": "buf/blen",
    "code": "int stun_get_message_len_str(uint8_t *buf, size_t blen, int padding, size_t *app_len)",
    "note": "STUN header checks fail because the input is not a valid STUN message (no magic cookie)."
  },
  {
    "step": 6,
    "file": "src/client/ns_turn_msg.c",
    "function": "stun_get_message_len_str",
    "line": 921,
    "var": "http_len",
    "code": "const int http_len = is_http(((char *)buf), blen);",
    "note": "Falls through to HTTP detection, passing the non-null-terminated 8192-byte buffer to is_http."
  },
  {
    "step": 7,
    "file": "src/client/ns_turn_msg.c",
    "function": "is_http",
    "line": 870,
    "var": "s/blen",
    "code": "int is_http(const char *s, size_t blen)",
    "note": "blen=8192 >= 12 passes the initial length check."
  },
  {
    "step": 8,
    "file": "src/client/ns_turn_msg.c",
    "function": "is_http",
    "line": 872,
    "var": "strstr(s, GET )",
    "code": "if ((strstr(s, GET ) == s) || (strstr(s, POST ) == s) || ...)",
    "note": "strstr scans the non-null-terminated buffer for GET. Since the buffer is full of 0x41 bytes with no null terminator within bounds, strstr reads past the 8192-byte stack buffer, causing a stack-buffer-overflow READ."
  }
]
EOF
echo "Trace written" && python3 -c "import json; data=json.load(open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')); print(f'Valid JSON with {len(data)} steps')"
